summary: Comprehensive architectural and UX implementation plan for the Trading Strategy Playbook & Community Backtest Journal (ট্রেডিং স্ট্র্যাটেজি প্লেবুক ও ব্যাকটেস্টিং জার্নাল হাব). Covers session-based analytics (London, New York, Asia), support/resistance setups, timeframe/candlestick tracking, TradingView screenshot uploads, YouTube video embeds, win/loss charts, pass/fail post-mortem notes, public vs private visibility, owner-only editing permissions, and community commenting/upvoting with persistent database synchronization.
